title: Agent eval golden case
description: One frozen golden case for the subagent eval harness (docs/plans/shipped/subagent-eval-harness.md). Records enough repo context to RECONSTRUCT the run — a frozen diff alone is not reproducible (plan § Case metadata / RISK review finding 5). Consumed by scripts/dev/agent-eval-run.sh to drive the agent; the resulting findings are scored by scripts/dev/agent-eval-score.py against this case's dimensions + referenceOutcome.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only on a breaking shape change.

caseId.description: Stable identifier. Base + head result JSONs scored together MUST share this caseId.

agent.description: Agent under eval, e.g. 'code-review' (matches agents/<name>.md basename).

description.description: One-line human summary of what this case probes.

repoRef.description: Commit SHA the runner reconstructs the run against.

baseBranch.description: Branch the diff is taken relative to (e.g. 'develop').

files.description: Relevant file paths handed to the agent as context.

diff.description: Optional unified diff (inline) or a repo-relative path to a .diff fixture.

toolPosture.description: Tool posture the agent runs under. code-review is read-only.

delegationPacket.description: The EXACT delegation packet text handed to the agent — the prompt the runner feeds the harness adapter.

dimensions.description: Scored quality dimensions. 'judge' kind → external judge command; 'objective' kind → inline code check (plan § Approach step 2).

key.description: Dimension identifier, unique within the case (e.g. 'correctness', 'cited_file_line').

kind.description: 'judge' → graded by the external judge command; 'objective' → graded by an inline deterministic code check.

weight.description: Optional relative weight (default 1.0). Reserved for a future aggregate score; the MVP scores per-dimension.

check.description: Required when kind=objective: which inline check computes the score from trial.findings.

referenceOutcome.description: Ground truth the judge + objective checks score against.

expectedFindingCount.description: How many genuine findings the case expects. Used by the 'finding_count' objective check and given to the judge as context.

allowedSeverities.description: Severity enum the 'severity_enum' objective check accepts (default: critical/high/medium/low/info).

expectedFindings.description: The known-good findings — what a strong agent run should surface. Given to the judge as the reference answer.

notes.description: Free-text guidance for a human or judge (e.g. known false-positive traps in this case).
